import numpy as np

# Compare predictions: with vs. without L0H0_ATTN
inputs = [
    ["BOS", "a", "b", "c", "a", "b", "c", "a", "b", "c"],
    ["BOS", "b", "b", "a", "a", "b", "b", "a", "a", "a"],
    ["BOS", "c", "c", "a", "c", "a", "c", "c", "a", "a"]
]

# r3 = baseline, r6 = L0H0_ATTN zero-ablated
r3 = np.load('/work/fwd/r3/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
r6 = np.load('/work/fwd/r6/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)

class_names = {0: 'a', 1: 'b', 2: 'c'}
pred3 = np.argmax(r3['logits'], axis=-1)
pred6 = np.argmax(r6['logits'], axis=-1)

for i, inp in enumerate(inputs):
    print(f"\nInput {i}: {inp}")
    print(f"  Baseline:  {[class_names[p] for p in pred3[i]]}")
    print(f"  Ablated:   {[class_names[p] for p in pred6[i]]}")
    # Show which positions changed
    for pos in range(10):
        if pred3[i][pos] != pred6[i][pos]:
            print(f"  ** pos {pos} ({inp[pos]}): {class_names[pred3[i][pos]]} -> {class_names[pred6[i][pos]]} (CHANGED)")
